title: Demain 1924
identity: Jean Cras, Demain (Prélude et danse), 1924–26. Current saxophone duo repertoire sources identify an edition for soprano saxophone and piano (ed. Nicolas Prost); separate secondary sources describe a manuscript saxophone quartet, so these may be distinct scorings or versions.

evidence.claim: Professional saxophonist Pantelis Lykoudis lists Demain (ed. Nicolas Prost), dated 1924–26, for soprano saxophone and piano.
Wikipedia worklist describes a saxophone quartet manuscript under Prélude et danse: Demain; relation to the separately listed soprano/piano edition is not established.
